svg.title: CO2 growth rate by 10-degree latitude band from OCO-2, 2015 to April 2026
svg.desc: Heat map of CO₂ growth rate in ten 10-degree latitude bands, from the southern to the northern mid-latitudes, January 2015 to April 2026, with red where growth was faster than usual (the median of all band-months, 2.39 ppm per year) and blue where slower. Numbered boxes mark (1) the 2015–16 El Niño in the southern tropics, (2) the 2019–20 Australian Black Summer fires, (3) the 2023 Canada fires and (4) the 2023–24 Amazon drought and fires.
